grammar.topic: 1st conditional: if + present simple, will + verb
explainTr: Gerçekten olabilecek durumları anlatırken 1st conditional kullanırsın: If + present simple, will + yalın fiil. If it rains, we will stay inside. If bölümü başta ise sonuna virgül koyarsın.
Çok sık yapılan hata: if'ten sonra 'will' kullanmak. If it will rain değil, If it rains denir. Gelecekten söz etsen bile if bölümü şimdiki zamanla kurulur.
Olumsuz için won't kullanılır: If you don't study, you won't pass. Sonuç kısmında can, must gibi kelimeler de gelebilir: If you finish, you can go out. Okul kurallarında bu yapı çok işine yarar.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'yağmur yağarsa kalırız' tek bir -sa/-ır yapısıyla kurulur. İngilizcede iki parça var: If it rains (şimdiki zaman) + we will stay (will + fiil). 'If it will rain' Türkçeden gelen tipik bir hatadır.

reading.title: Hafsa's first rules
reading.text:
On Monday morning, Hafsa arrives at Lincoln Elementary School for her first substitute job. Mr. Brown, the school secretary, gives her a folder. "Read the school rules before class," he says. "If you know the rules, the day will be much easier."

Hafsa sits in the front office and reads. The rules are simple. Students must walk in the hallway. They must listen when the teacher talks, and they must respect each other. If a student breaks a rule, the teacher gives a warning. If the student breaks the rule again, the teacher will call the front office. A serious problem, like bullying, goes to the principal. The student may get detention, and the parents will receive a phone call.

There are rules for adults too. Substitute teachers must wear a name badge, and they must not use their phones in class. "If a child needs permission to leave the room, he or she takes the hall pass," Mr. Brown explains. "No pass, no walking in the hallway."

Hafsa feels nervous, but she also feels ready. At 8:30 she walks into Room 12 with the folder in her hand. A boy raises his hand. "Excuse me, can I go to the bathroom?" Hafsa smiles and points to the pass on the wall. "Of course. If you take the pass, you can go," she says. Her first rule works!

writing.promptTr: Sınıfındaki velilere kısa bir mesaj yaz: üç kural söyle ve kuralı bozarsa ne olacağını if cümleleriyle anlat.
writing.promptEn: Write a short message to the parents of your class. Explain three rules and use if-sentences to say what will happen if students break them.
frames: If they run in the hallway, ...
writing.model: Dear parents, welcome to our class! I want to explain three simple rules. First, students must arrive on time. If a student is late, he or she will sign the late list in the front office. Second, we respect each other. If a student says something unkind, I will talk to him or her after class. Third, students walk in the hallway. If they run, they will lose a few minutes of recess. If you have a question, please send me an email. I am sure we will have a great year together. Thank you for your help. Best regards, Hafsa
checklistTr: If cümlesinde present simple, sonuçta 'will' kullandın mı (if it will rain değil)?
En az üç kural ve üç if cümlesi var mı?
Selamlama ve kapanış (Dear parents / Best regards) var mı?
